evidence.quote: NIST has developed a framework to better manage risks to individuals, organizations, and society associated with artificial intelligence (AI)
improve the ability to incorporate trustworthiness considerations into the design, development, use, and evaluation of AI products, services, and systems
consensus-driven, open, transparent, and collaborative process
The NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) is intended for voluntary use
intended for voluntary use and to improve the ability to incorporate trustworthiness considerations
